MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     MAX(CASE
       WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14'))
       ELSE DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), CAST(REPLACE(p.death_date, '/', '-') AS DATE))
     END) AS highest_age
RETURN nationality AS col1, highest_age AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14') AS end_date
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
         OR (CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
             AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(end_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2
